7 Brew Brew Lagoon 7 Fizz Soda: Price, Calories & Caffeine

A medium Brew Lagoon 7 Fizz Soda is about $3.50, with 250 calories, 0 mg of caffeine and 64 g of sugar. Every number here comes from 7 Brew's own published nutrition guide, broken out by size and preparation.

Brew Lagoon 7 Fizz Soda allergens

7 Brew's published allergen guide lists no declared allergens for the standard Brew Lagoon 7 Fizz Soda. Adding a milk, syrup or topping changes this, and every drink is made on shared equipment, so cross-contact is possible.

If you are ordering around an allergy, check the full allergen and dietary guide and confirm at the window.

How to order a Brew Lagoon 7 Fizz Soda

Ask for it by name — it is on the standard board at every 7 Brew, so no special script is needed. Say the size first, then the drink: "Can I get a medium Brew Lagoon 7 Fizz Soda?"

Worth knowing before you order: the base is customisable. You can swap milk, ask for sugar-free syrups, change the sweetness level, or have most drinks made iced, hot or blended as a frozen chiller where the menu allows. Ordering through the app earns 100 rewards points either way.

7 Brew Brew Lagoon 7 Fizz Soda FAQ

How many calories are in a 7 Brew Brew Lagoon 7 Fizz Soda?

A medium iced Brew Lagoon 7 Fizz Soda has 250 calories. A small has 170 and a large 340, according to 7 Brew's nutrition guide.

How much caffeine is in a 7 Brew Brew Lagoon 7 Fizz Soda?

About 0 mg in a medium. Small is 0 mg and large is 0 mg.

How much does a 7 Brew Brew Lagoon 7 Fizz Soda cost?

Roughly $2.75 for a small, $3.50 for a medium and $4.25 for a large. Prices are our estimates and vary by stand — every 7 Brew is independently owned.

How much sugar is in a 7 Brew Brew Lagoon 7 Fizz Soda?

64 g in a medium.
